summary: Three churches (Epiphany of Our Lord, Immaculate Conception, St. Joseph) with one schedule box in the bulletin that agrees across all five issues read. Weekend and weekday Masses, a Confession box, First Saturday Mass at Epiphany, weekly Monday Adoration at Immaculate Conception and First Friday Adoration at Immaculate Conception and St. Joseph are all settled. No open questions.
